title: WordPress Redesign
meta: Give your WordPress site a fresh, faster look while keeping your content and search setup. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WordPress redesign that keeps your content and links
overview: If your WordPress site looks tired, we redesign it without starting over. We review the current pages, agree a new look with you, then rebuild the layouts, fonts, colors and images on a private staging copy. Your text, links and search titles stay in place, so you keep what already works. When you approve the new design, we move it live and check every main page on desktop and phone.

pkgs.blurb: A fresh look for your home page and one key inner page.
A new design across your main pages with a modern header and footer.
A complete redesign with custom sections and a speed pass.

faq: Will the redesign hurt my search rankings?
We aim to protect them by keeping page addresses, titles and text where possible and testing before launch. Big layout changes can still move rankings a little, and no one can promise otherwise.
Do I need to give you a design?
No. Send a few sites you like and your brand colors and we propose the look. If you already have a design in Figma, we build from that.
Can you keep my current theme?
Often, yes, if it is well made. If it is slow or outdated we suggest a lighter one and show you why before changing anything.
Will the site go down during the redesign?
No. We work on a staging copy and your live site stays untouched until you approve, so visitors see no break while the work is underway.
